 Dated this the 6th day of February, 2025
 Judgment
The writ petition has been filed on the apprehension that the respondents will lay pipelines in the properties of the petitioners, even without completing the acquisition process.
2. A statement has been filed by the 4th respondent.

It is stated that as at present Section 4 (1)
notification has been published on 17.01.2025 and it is also undertaken that the 4 th respondent or their representatives will not enter private properties for road work until all legal formalities are completed, compensation is fully paid to the affected landowners and the land is handed over to the KRFB by the Land Acquisition Officer.
The above submission is recorded.
This writ petition is closed and it is directed that without completing the formalities of acquisition, the petitioners shall not be dispossessed of their lands.

The rights available to the petitioners pursuant to Section WP(C) NO.2614 OF 2025 2025:KER:9916 4 (1) notification and subsequent notifications are still available to the petitioners and the petitioners may act accordingly.

Sd/-
